name: Dáka (Hungary)
description: Five horizontal stripes of blue, white, blue, white and blue in the ratio 1:1:1:1:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Dáka: a blue shield with a white ear of grain, a ploughshare and a coulter.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
